CustomField.inlineHelpText: The L3 Slack Group is used for Case Escalations. For example, when a L3 Escalation for this team is raised this group (or groups) will receive a @ slack notification in the corresponding L2 channel. To specify a single group, simply type in the group name, patchsme or specify multiple groups via comma separated values patchsme,smegroupfoo.
CustomField.label: L3 Slack Groups
